items.reason: "Create a Credit token" supplies what Taramyn's "defeat a Credit token (belonging to any player)" spends. Agrees with haiku.
Aerie deals "2 damage to a base" (choosable as enemy base), enabling "If you've dealt damage to an enemy base this phase". Agrees with haiku.
Aphra only discards from deck and returns a card to hand; it plays no unit, so Greef's "When you play or create a unit" is not fed. Agrees with haiku.
"Play a unit from your hand" triggers Greef's "When you play or create a unit". Agrees with haiku.
Paige Tico's Piloting plays her as an upgrade on a Vehicle; Razor Crest is a Vehicle with "When a Pilot attaches to this unit". Agrees with haiku.
"When Played: Create a Credit token" feeds Taramyn's "defeat a Credit token". Agrees with haiku.

Bail Organa's hand discard feeds no Gideon text: Gideon has no "when you discard" trigger and his deploy side only concerns keywords on an Imperial unit in the discard pile (Bail is Republic). Agrees with haiku.
"Exhaust a unit" can hit an enemy, which Sandstorm punishes: "Give a Weakness token to each exhausted enemy unit". Agrees with haiku.
Chewbacca has Piloting for a Vehicle; Razor Crest triggers on "When a Pilot attaches to this unit". Agrees with haiku.
Acklay's "Deal 2 damage to each enemy base" satisfies Baylan's "If an enemy base was damaged this phase"; agrees with haiku.
Kylo's "Discard a card from your hand" does not match Sebulba's "When you discard a card from your deck". Agrees with haiku.
Bodhi can give a friendly Rebel ground unit Sentinel, which Command Shuttle buffs: "Each friendly ground unit with Sentinel gets +0/+2". Agrees with haiku.
"Heal 3 damage from a unit" can target Baze, triggering "When 1 or more damage is healed from this unit". Agrees with haiku.
"Return an upgrade that costs 3 or less" can take a Pilot upgrade back to hand to be replayed onto Razor Crest ("When a Pilot attaches"). Agrees with haiku.
Luke's "heal 1 damage from that unit" after a friendly attack can heal Baze, triggering his damage-dealing ability. Agrees with haiku.
Magnaguard gives "2 Weakness tokens to it", meaning itself (friendly), but Rish Loo needs "an enemy non-leader unit with a Weakness token". Agrees with haiku.
Cid: "An opponent chooses a unit they control. Give a Weakness token to it" supplies an enemy with a Weakness token for Rish Loo's steal (provided it is not a leader). Agrees with haiku.
"return an upgrade ... play it for free" can re-attach a Pilot to Red Leader, firing "When a Pilot upgrade attaches to this unit". Agrees with haiku.
"It gains Hidden for this phase" gives Dooku's "Each friendly unit with Hidden can't be attacked" a target when Dooku is played later that phase. Agrees with haiku.

Gideon's action just plays a unit from hand cheaper; his deploy side only gains keywords for itself when on an Imperial unit in the discard pile. Neither grants Shielded to a board unit for The Armorer. Overrides haiku (unsure to wrong).
"Return an upgrade that costs 2 or less" can recycle a cost-2 Pilot upgrade like Paige Tico onto Razor Crest again. Agrees with haiku.

Oppo Rancisis "gains ... Shielded while another friendly unit has" it, so with the Armorer in play Oppo has Shielded and gets a Shield token from "each friendly unit with Shielded". Agrees with haiku.
"Defeat a friendly upgrade" triggers Zeb's "When a friendly upgrade is defeated". Agrees with haiku.
Shield tokens are upgrades, so "defeat a Shield token on a friendly Gungan unit" is a friendly upgrade defeat that fires Zeb. Overrides haiku (wrong to correct).
Experience tokens are upgrades, so "defeat an Experience token on a friendly unit" fires Zeb's "When a friendly upgrade is defeated". Overrides haiku (wrong to correct).
